previousEvidence.scope: Original 1ddd32e recording preserved byte-for-byte; current evidence is independently regenerated on Linux, not substituted Windows evidence.

portrait.status: Public domain per scikit-image dataset documentation

architecture.status: Released worldwide into the public domain by author

reproducibility.scope: Same frozen points and same-environment replay checked by examples/reconstruction-study/replay.py; cross-build exact geometry is not independently verified. Encoder byte identity is not pixel identity. Runtime measurements vary.
reproducibility.decodedPixelHash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 WIDTHxHEIGHT:RGBA8 + newline followed by Pillow-converted row-major RGBA8 bytes
reproducibility.frozenPoints: Committed rounded five-decimal points bypass floating CDF/RNG sampling differences during replay. Cell assignment still uses the recorded SciPy build; fixture and script hashes are line-ending independent.
reproducibility.textPortability: Text artifacts are written with explicit UTF-8 and LF; .gitattributes keeps the study tree LF on Windows checkouts.
reproducibility.priorRepeatClaim: v1 repeatGeometryAndRasterHashesIdentical meant same-machine/build only; superseded by this scoped record.

sameEnvironmentReplay.scope: Exact generated LF SVG bytes and canonical decoded RGBA8 hashes only; encoder bytes, timings and PDF bytes excluded.

acceptance.note: Coverage controlled, geometry complexity disclosed rather than matched, local tone residuals reported. Digital tone metrics do not measure artistic usefulness.
